nodes.title: 1. Intro
widgets_values:
In this video, I will introduce the process of applying Detailer to AnimateDiff videos using 
"Detailer For AnimateDiff." 

Unlike the previous approach, where Detailer was applied individually on a frame-by-frame basis, 
this node follows the same sampling process as AnimateDiff. 

Therefore, it allows for maintaining consistent video quality compared to the previous method.

nodes.title: 3. Original Image
widgets_values: The crew member aboard the spaceship has a significantly distorted facial structure due to the low resolution, with almost the entire body fitting into the frame.

widgets_values_named.text: The crew member aboard the spaceship has a significantly distorted facial structure due to the low resolution, with almost the entire body fitting into the frame.

nodes.title: 4. Face Detail
widgets_values:
Using the "Simple Detector for AnimateDiff," we detect the facial region in the image generated and create SEGS.
This node consolidates the detected masks from the entire frame and creates SEGS.

The detected SEGS are passed as input to "Detailer For AnimateDiff." 

This node applies a unified SEGS to all frames, performing the detailing operation in the style of AnimateDiff. 

Using a mask applied consistently across all frames helps prevent inconsistencies in response to frame changes.

The improved SEGS through Detailer is composited onto the original image using "SEGSPaste."

nodes.title: 7. Manual Inpaint
widgets_values:
Similar to the face Detailer, but instead of SEGS created using Detector, we generate a region to redraw using 
"MASK to SEGS."

Modify the positive prompt in the basic_pipe connected to Detailer to "spaceman uniform pants."

Similarly, use Detailer and SEGSPaste to create detailing and the final image. 
However, this time, use an image with applied face detail as input instead of the original image to generate an image with both facial and bottom transformations.

nodes.title: 6. Mask
widgets_values:
Next, let's go a step further and change the skirt to pants using the mask. 

To draw the mask accurately, we copy a static image of one frame as a Preview Image instead of using Video Combine for the original image. 

We paste it into "Load Image" and apply a mask to the area to be changed into pants.
